operatorProperties.code:
def process(constitutionBeach) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = constitutionBeach.copy()

    # Parse dates; keep only 2024
    df['DateParsed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['DateParsed'].dt.year == 2024].copy()

    # Build numeric enterococcus values for each sampling point.
    # Tags indicate censored values like "< 10" or "> 200"; use the reported numeric part.
    # Standard threshold is 104, so censored direction doesn't affect pass/fail unless censoring crosses 104,
    # which won't happen for typical "<" at low values; for ">", numeric already exceeds threshold.
    for col in ['Enterococcus', 'Enterococcus.1', 'Enterococcus.2']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    ent = df[['Enterococcus', 'Enterococcus.1', 'Enterococcus.2']]

    # For each day, evaluate pass/fail among available samples (non-null)
    passMask = ent.lt(104)

    anyPass = passMask.any(axis=1)
    anyFail = (~passMask) & ent.notna()
    anyFail = anyFail.any(axis=1)

    discordant = anyPass & anyFail

    out = pd.DataFrame({'discordant_days_2024': [int(discordant.sum())]})
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Compute number of 2024 dates where at least one Constitution Beach sampling point meets Enterococcus standard (<104) and at least one other point does not: parse Date to datetime; filter year==2024; coerce Enterococcus, Enterococcus.1, Enterococcus.2 to numeric; per row compute anyPass (any value <104) and anyFail (any non-null value >=104); count rows where both true; return single-row DataFrame with discordant_days_2024.
